rows.en: Lodis: "It seems you managed to rescue her safely."
Ymir: "Yes. We had Lord Garyud's help as well.
How did things go on your end?"
Lodis: "They said things like, 'How dare you use
the Liebhofen without permission!'
Since when did the Liebhofen become
their property, I wonder?"
Forzen: "Politicians are the same in every age.
They only see things
in whatever way suits them.
Well, at any rate, we managed to silence them,
and Kasumi is safe. All's well that ends well."
Touya: "What's so great about it?!
This only happened in the first place
because you weren't doing your job!"
Forzen: "Ah, how embarrassing.
Well, let's let bygones be bygones
and think about what comes next."
Touya: "You know, you..."
Kasumi: "Touya-chan, it isn't Mr. Forzen's fault.
He helped me when I felt
as though my anxiety would crush me."
Touya: "W-well, sure, but..."
Kasumi: "And I've been able to see you again, Touya-chan.
I think things have worked out for the best."
Lodis: "I'm glad you are such a kindhearted young woman.
I hope you never lose that kindness..."
Kasumi: "Huh? Y-yes..."
Lodis: "I see. You must be confused.
Don't worry. We will take responsibility
for your life here. There is no need to be afraid."
Kasumi: "U-um..."
Fain: "Y-Y-Y-Your Highness?!"
Celica: "All right, that's enough. Brother, I know you're trying
to encourage her, but I told you to stop casually taking people's hands
and gazing into their eyes, didn't I?
That's why you're always getting into trouble, you know.
...Besides, don't you feel a piercing stare at the back of your neck?"
Sisk: "..."
Lodis: "W-well, there is Kasumi's situation to consider,
and we need to hear your report.
Shall we go to Lady Ivel's room?"
Kasumi: "Um..."
Lodis: "Is something wrong?"
Kasumi: "I'd like to help
all of you too..."
Ymir: "Do you mean
you want to fight alongside us?"
Kasumi: "Yes. Apparently I have the aptitude to pilot those robots,
and I've heard you're short of people.
I can't just ignore people in trouble.
If there is anything I can do to help,
please let me."
Kasumi: "...Besides, I've finally found Touya-chan again.
I don't want us to be separated..."
Lodis: "I see... In that case,
we could hardly ask for more. But... Are you really sure?"
Kasumi: "Yes."
Aurelie: "I don't like it.
'I want to be near the boy I love.' I don't want someone piloting
a Spirit Mech with such a naive attitude."
Ymir: "Aurelie?!"
Aurelie: "We aren't professional fighters either.
And the fighting is only going to get harder.
If you let those flighty feelings guide you then,
you could put everyone around you in danger too.
To put it bluntly, you'd be a burden."
Defend Kasumi
Stay quiet
Touya: "I get what you're trying to say,
but don't talk to her like that."
Kasumi: "Touya-chan..."
Aurelie: "...This isn't a game. It's real combat.
And can you really fight?
You might have to kill someone, you know?!"
Kasumi: "That's..."
Aurelie: "If you pilot a Spirit Mech thinking like that,
YOU'LL be the one who dies!"
Kasumi: "..."
Clovis: "Aurelie..."
Aurelie: "Wh-what?"
Clovis: "You're kind, aren't you?
You think Kasumi couldn't bear the fighting, don't you?"
Aurelie: "..."
Clovis: "Like you just said,
this isn't a game. It's a battle.
Someday, she'll take a person's life with her own hands.
And when that happens, the guilt might
crush her... Just as it once did you."
Touya: "That happened to you...?"
Aurelie: "...It was a long time ago."
Kasumi: "I..."
Aurelie: "...*sigh* Don't look at me like that.
You're making it look like I'm bullying you."
Kasumi: "I-I'm sorry..."
Aurelie: "...Do what you want.
But I've warned you."
Kasumi: "Aurelie..."
Touya: "Don't look so down."
Kasumi: "Hey, Touya-chan... Is it really okay for me to stay here?
Am I just causing trouble for everyone...?"
Touya: "What are you talking about? Of course not.
It's all right. Don't worry.
...Or don't you want to stay here?"
Kasumi: "No! It's not that!"
Touya: "Then don't let it bother you.
Besides, if it comes down to it, I'll protect you."
Kasumi: "...Okay. I believe you."
Kasumi: "Th-that's not..."
Fain: "That's not true! Look into her eyes!
Someone with eyes like hers would never lie!
Even if God himself would permit such a thing,
I, Fain Jin Barion, will not!!"
Aurelie: "No, I never said a word about her lying..."
Fain: "Besides, if she were in danger...
I-I would... h-her..."
Clovis: "Oho, you'd protect her, would you?
I knew it... You've fallen for her."
Fain: "Wh-what?! Wh-wh-wh-what are you talking about?!"
Aurelie: "...This isn't a game. It's real combat.
And can you really fight?
You might have to kill someone, you know?!"
Kasumi: "That's..."
Aurelie: "If you pilot a Spirit Mech thinking like that,
YOU'LL be the one who dies!"
Kasumi: "..."
Clovis: "Aurelie..."
Aurelie: "Wh-what?"
Clovis: "You're kind, aren't you?
You think Kasumi couldn't bear the fighting, don't you?"
Aurelie: "..."
Clovis: "Like you just said,
this isn't a game. It's a battle.
Someday, she'll take a person's life with her own hands.
And when that happens, the guilt might
crush her... Just as it once did you."
Touya: "That happened to you...?"
Aurelie: "...It was a long time ago."
Kasumi: "I..."
Aurelie: "...*sigh* Don't look at me like that.
You're making it look like I'm bullying you."
Kasumi: "I-I'm sorry..."
Aurelie: "...Well, it's your decision.
Do what you want. But I've warned you."
Kasumi: "Aurelie..."
Fain: "Don't worry! I'll protect you!"
Kasumi: "Huh? O-okay... Thank you..."
Lodis: "Well, Kasumi, you can come along
as a pilot candidate. We will have to conduct
an aptitude test. Is that all right with you?"
Kasumi: "Y-yes. Thank you for having me."
Lodis: "Then let us go to Lady Ivel's room."
Ivel: "...I see. So Garyud and the others
are safe... But if Zigrim is adopting Ze=Ode's
technology, that makes things all the more troublesome."
Lodis: "Yes. We do not know
Ze=Ode's aims, but with its newfound power, Zigrim's next target
will surely be the Kingdom of Agarthia."
Touya: "But why would those Ze=Ode bastards
go about things in such a roundabout way?"
Lodis: "It is hard to say. If we consider why they cannot act openly,
perhaps they have not recovered enough of their power,
or perhaps they are waiting for something..."
Ymir: "Ze=Ode is said to unleash its power when all six machines
are gathered. And so far, the appearance of its central machine,
Goderius, has not been confirmed.
It may be reasonable to assume they are waiting for it,
or making preparations for its appearance."
Touya: "For it to travel through time?"
Ymir: "No. Ze=Ode's appearance
was accidental. However brilliant Dr. Debish and the others may be,
even they cannot control time.
I don't know what means they intend to use, but they are certainly waiting
for Goderius and Dr. Debish."
Ai: "Then why did they attack York?!
That was nothing but an invasion!"
Arthur: "That's true.
But we were told that Ze=Ode is merely using Zigrim,
rather than taking it over.
Perhaps it has something to do with President Horem,
whom Garyud mentioned at the end?"
Lodis: "For a military operation on that scale,
there is no doubt that the president, as head of state,
gave his approval.
Though the current president is rumored to be a mere puppet
who only approves the assembly's decisions..."
Celica: "They call him 'dead weight,' don't they?"
Touya: "Huh. You have that expression in this world too."
Celica: "Pretty much. But if he's suddenly started taking action,
doesn't that mean the president himself is being controlled?"
Xiujian: "If that were so, Garyud would not have put it that way.
He spoke of it as a separate matter.
We should assume Ze=Ode and the president are unconnected.
Besides, rather than using someone so openly called a puppet,
it would be more reliable to win over someone
with greater influence. A senior military figure, for instance."
Lodis: "General Growster.
He certainly meets that condition.
One could say he has absolute control over the military."
Clovis: "Anyway, we still don't have enough information.
All we can do is keep an eye on Zigrim's movements."
Ivel: "Yes. Besides, your own problems
are beginning to come to the surface."
Touya: "What do you mean?"
Ivel: "The Spirit Mechs.
The Agarthian government has laid claim
to their ownership.
They say that because the Spirit Mechs were designed by the first princess, Celica,
Agarthia also has a right to own them.
They demand that we either hand over the machines with active pilots,
or become an Agarthian organization,
Liebhofen and all.
At this rate, they will clearly find some convenient pretext
to detain you.
Chairman Rakbal is working to influence the assembly,
but it will only buy us time."
Touya: "They can't just decide that...!"
Clovis: "That's governments for you, in the end."
Lodis: "It is utterly shameful.
To assert only their rights now, of all times..."
Celica: "Why don't we just ignore them?"
Ivel: "That is probably what it will come to.
The Liebhofen was built from the outset as the Spirit Mechs' mothership
and your base of operations.
Now that Ze=Ode's return is certain,
we must watch developments in every region."
Lodis: "As of today, we will establish a research organization
for the purpose of investigating Ze=Ode.
Its base will be the Liebhofen. Its members, of course, will be you."
Arthur: "So we're taking the initiative
before they can interfere..."
Lodis: "Unfortunately, Agarthia as it stands
does not have the capacity to accept you.
Nor is this something I can resolve through my personal influence alone."
Ivel: "They will no doubt continue to complain,
but the rights they claim never existed
in the first place.
There are any number of ways around them.
And after the recent broadcast, distrust of the government
has turned to criticism. The people's hopes
are gathering around the Spirit Mechs,
which stand openly against Ze=Ode.
They merely want to exploit that.
We need only turn it to our advantage."
Ymir: "Lady Ivel, in that case, I could stay with you..."
Ivel: "No. You must see the truth
with your own eyes."
Ymir: "The truth...?"
Ivel: "Yes. What Ze=Ode truly is,
and what they are trying to do.
I want you to go and see it in my place."
Ymir: "Lady Ivel..."
Ivel: "Besides, you can convince the council members
to recognize you as my representative.
To help us in our negotiations as well,
I want you to continue traveling with the Liebhofen."
Ymir: "...Understood.
I am honored to accept."
Celica: "Well, then..."
Lodis: "Celica, where are you going?"
Celica: "Huh? Oh, n-nowhere..."
Lodis: "...Don't go with them.
Father has told me
to bring you back."
Celica: "Okaaay..."
Revios: "Too late... To act only now, trying to acquire the Spirit Mechs...
With public opinion placing its hopes in them,
they have no need for a patron. It is far too late..."
Geel: "Excuse me, sir.
We have received a report of movement aboard the Liebhofen.
It seems they intend to reject the assembly's proposal."
Revios: "Heh heh heh. So that is their move.
His Highness has made quite a bold decision..."
Geel: "We could detain them now..."
Revios: "There is no need. Certainly, making them part of
Agarthia now might win public opinion to our side.
But the achievements would be theirs, not ours.
Nothing will change if we keep relying on the strength
of people from another world. We must protect our nation's prestige
with our own hands."
Geel: "But they would be an ideal military asset to exploit..."
Revios: "Indeed, power is a matter of how you use it. But now is not the time.
To tame a wild beast, you do not pull its fangs.
You must weaken it and force it to submit.
The greater people's expectations,
the stronger their reaction when those expectations are betrayed.
It would be wiser to wait until then."
Geel: "Yes, sir. It was not my place
to offer an opinion.
...As for Zigrim's reply,
it was as we expected.
At this rate, war may be unavoidable."
Revios: "No doubt. Those fools know only how to brandish our nation's prestige.
They could never handle negotiations.
Events never unfold exactly as they do in a textbook."
Geel: "Surely you should be the one to lead us, Your Excellency..."
Revios: "...Colonel. As soldiers, we have a duty to obey
and carry out the government's decisions.
An army that acts for its own ends is no different from bandits."
Geel: "But..."
Revios: "I am not dissatisfied with the nation's system.
It is the stupidity of the people who make it up that I cannot tolerate.
I have no intention of becoming a politician, nor do I think I could.
It would not suit me, for one thing."
Geel: "..."
Revios: "Colonel, I am proud to be a soldier.
I thought you felt the same?"
Geel: "...I spoke out of turn."
Revios: "Good. ...Come to think of it, how is that other matter progressing?"
Geel: "Without difficulty. We are currently conducting
tests with prototypes. However, for mass production,
Renbardon appears more suitable."
Revios: "I see. Then proceed along those lines, with all haste."
Geel: "Yes, sir."
Revios: "...One more thing, Colonel.
I would like you to refrain from acting on your own from now on."
Geel: "What are you referring to, sir?"
Revios: "Would Dr. Berol's laboratory mean anything to you?
Security weak enough to be breached by such a poor hacker is a problem,
but employing someone like that is a greater one."
Geel: "...Yes, sir."
Touya: "Whew. Is that everything? ...Hm?"
Yamato: "Come on, don't stop working... What's wrong?"
Touya: "Isn't that... Rayblade?"
Yamato: "It is. We're taking Rayblade too..."
Ymir: "That's right."
Touya: "Oh, Ymir."
Ymir: "Lady Ivel told us to take it,
since leaving it here would be more dangerous."
Yamato: "True. Once the Spirit Mechs are gone,
someone might try to get hold of Rayblade, you knyow."
Ymir: "Yes. Though Rayblade still isn't completely
repaired, so we can't use it yet."
Touya: "I see. And here I was... Huh? That scent..."
Ymir: "Oh, this? Lady Ivel gave it to me.
It smells nice, doesn't it?"
Touya: "...It's the same scent as that time..."
Ymir: "Is something wrong?"
Touya: "Oh, no..."
Ymir: "Really?
Well then, let's head to the bridge."
Touya: "Y-yeah..."
Maki: "There's no one around, right?"
Reisuke: "Beep-boop-boop-boop."
Maki: "All right! Now!"
Maki: "Infiltration successful! Heh heh... The next Roguewar Prize
is mine. Just you watch... I'm going to uncover
the truth about Rayblade..."
Kasumi: "So this is a Spirit Mech...
It looks so big up close...
What is... this feeling...?"
Ai: "They say that one's called Orbest."
Kasumi: "M-Miss... Ai."
Ai: "Just Ai is fine. We're going to be teammates,
and if we don't get rid of these barriers at the start,
they'll just drag on forever.
Besides, I don't like formal speech."
Kasumi: "Wh-why is that... if I may ask?"
Ai: "See? That. It makes us sound like strangers, doesn't it?
I think that as long as you respect the other person,
that's enough, even without putting it into words.
There's no need to get hung up on formalities.
What matters is how you feel, right?"
Kasumi: "You're amazing, Miss Ai."
Ai: "Ai."
Kasumi: "Ai... chan."
Ai: "*sigh*... Well, fine.
From today on, it's 'Ai-chan,' then.
And I'm younger than you,
so you don't need to be so formal with me.
In return, can I just call you Kasumi?"
Kasumi: "Yes, of course... Oh, y-yeah..."
Ai: "Very good."
Kasumi: "Heh heh heh."
Ai: "Heh heh... Ha ha ha ha!"
Kasumi: "I was a little worried, because I didn't feel
very welcome... But I'm glad
there's someone like you who'll talk to me..."
Ai: "What about him?"
Kasumi: "Him...? Oh, Touya-chan?
Well, Touya-chan is different. He talks rough,
but he's always stood up for me. He's very kind."
Ai: "Touya... chan, huh.
...So, honestly, how far have you two gone?"
Kasumi: "Huh? How far...? Oh..."
Ai: "No way... Y-you've gone that far already?!
You look so quiet, but you've been getting up to things..."
Kasumi: "N-no! Touya-chan and I haven't...
We... We've only kissed..."
Ai: "Whaaat?! Kissed?! I was only joking..."
Kasumi: "What?! B-but that was an accident, or,
well, a coincidence..."
Ai: "I wonder about thaaat..."
Kasumi: "..."
Ai: "Oh! S-sorry! Come on, don't look at me
with those eyes... Okay, okay! You don't seem like the sort
who'd lie, Kasumi. Yeah. I believe you."
Kasumi: "...But why would you ask me that?"
Ai: "N-no reason!
Y-you know, childhood friends becoming a couple is the standard thing, right?
Kasumi: "Isn't that in manga and things...?"
Ai: "W-well, anyway, that's why...
Now, then... Isn't it about time we left?
...See you!"
Kasumi: "???"
Ai: "Hmm, you know, childhood friends becoming a couple
is about as basic as it gets in manga.
I was wondering how it works in real life."
Kasumi: "Touya-chan doesn't seem...
to think of me that way, though..."
Ai: "Maybe he does. His whole expression changed
when he heard you were the one who'd gone missing."
Kasumi: "R-really?!"
Ai: "What would I get out of lying about that?
Well, knowing him, he'd do the same for anyone..."
Kasumi: "..."
Ai: "Ah! No, no! I'm sure you're special, Kasumi. Yeah."
Kasumi: "Heh heh. I was kidding.
Touya-chan is kind to everyone,
so I'm sure he'd do everything he could to save someone else too.
That's one of the good things about him."
Ai: "Heeey! You tricked me!"
Kasumi: "Eee!"
Ai: "Kind... Huh. Yeah, he is..."
Mechanic E: "Forstin, Orbest and Ahti
are loaded."
Mechanic A: "All right! Now for the spare parts."
Mechanic C: "I-I'll go get them!"
Mechanic D: "What's wrong? Did you forget
to say goodbye to your girlfriend?"
Mechanic C: "It isn't like that!"
Mechanic B: "I wonder about that."
Mechanic F: "Then maybe I'll come along too."
Mechanic A: "You lot, quit yapping and get to work!
We're sailing soon! Hurry up and load that thing too!"
Mechanic B: "All right, let's finish this in a flash!"
Mechanic C: "But... Are you sure this is all right?"
Mechanic A: "Are you really okay with saying goodbye to Princess Celica?"
Mechanic D: "Princess Celica is our true 'Chief'!
For her, I'd become a traitor to the nation or anything else!"
Mechanic A: "No, I wouldn't go quite that far..."
Lodis: "...They've gone."
Ivel: "Yes. They have inherited our wishes and Queen Alforina's.
I'm sure they will..."
Lodis: "Then let us do what we can."
Ivel: "We will be busy.
Oh, yes. She left this for you."
Lodis: "Hm? A message box...?"
Dear Brother,
I've decided to go after all.
There's Rayblade's repair work,
and the countermeasure to Ze=Ode's field.
Besides, I want to see with my own eyes
just what the Spirit Mechs I made can do.
So, I'll leave the rest to you.
See you! Bye-bye!
Lodis: "...Lady Ivel, did you know about this?"
Ivel: "Oh ho ho ho ho!"
Lodis: "*sigh*... What am I supposed to tell
Father...?"
Ivel: "I will do what I can to support you as well."
Lodis: "Yes, please..."
Derock: "Hah, hee, hoo... *huff, puff*...
I-I'm the brainwork type, you know... This sort of thing is..."
Touya: "Hm? Hey, Derock, isn't it?"
Ymir: "What's the matter? Carrying such a big bag..."
Derock: "I-it's nothing, you know.
This contains my most private possessions, you know.
It's dangerous to touch, so you'd better stay away, you know."
Touya: "Hmm... Well, whatever."
Ymir: "Then let's go on ahead."
Touya: "Yeah..."
Derock: "Whew... Time for a little rest, you know...
Heave-ho."
Touya: "Hm? ...What was that voice?
It sounded like it came from inside that bag..."
Derock: "Wh-whatever could you mean?
I-I haven't the faintest idea, you know..."
Touya: "...Hyaah!"
Derock: "Wh-what are you doing, you know?!
L-let go, you know!"
Touya: "Ymir! Get it while you can!"
Derock: "N-no, you can't, you know! That's..."
Celica: "H-hellooo..."
Ymir: "..."
Yamato: "Celica?!"
Touya: "You..."
Celica: "But I'd be bored back at the palace...
And I'm the Spirit Mechs' chief designer.
It would be inconvenient in all sorts of ways without me."
Touya: "Does Lodis know about... Of course he doesn't..."
Ymir: "...*sigh* I suppose it can't be helped.
I'll report it to His Highness later."
Celica: "Yes!"
Ymir: "But you are going to explain yourself properly too, all right?"
Celica: "Awww..."
Ymir: "Don't 'awww' me! Understood?!"
Celica: "Okaaay."
Sisk: "Huh? Princess Celica, weren't you staying in the Holy Land...?"
Celica: "Heh heh. Well, you know...
Anyway, where are we going now?"
Sisk: "..."
Captain Roa: "..."
Celica: "Huh? Don't we have a destination?
...What are we going to do?"
Ymir: "Well, for now..."
Gabon: "The engine room. Again."
Touya: "Engine trouble again?
Didn't we put into dock in the Holy Land?"
Ymir: "Is it serious?"
Gabon: "Well, unlike last time, navigation should be fine
as long as we don't push it too hard.
We're checking it now, just in case."
Ymir: "I see. Then please report
any problems."
Gabon: "Understood."
Touya: "What is it this time?"
Miyasco: "Oh, an incoming transmission!
It's breaking into our channel!"
Ymir: "Put it on the monitor!"
Murk: "Greetings, people of the Liebhofen.
I am the great authority on bioengineering,
Murk Elk Berol!"
Touya: "What's with that old guy?"
Ymir: "Berol...? Could it be...?"
Murk: "Oh! Is that Ymir I see?
Has it been five years?"
Ymir: "Y-yes. It's been a long time."
Celica: "You know him?"
Ymir: "Y-yes... He was Professor Rakbal's teacher, and I attended
some of his lectures myself. I heard he became director of the Artificial Evolution
Research Institute five years ago..."
Murk: "At present, I have become a wanderer,
traveling about to gather valuable data.
This is what happens when they cut the Gazette Project's budget again,
when it was already so small!"
Ymir: "The Gazette Project...
Doctor, did you create the Baluamy?!"
Murk: "Indeed! They are my pride and joy!"
Touya: "Then you're the one responsible
for making those things breed everywhere?!"
Murk: "How rude! That was purely an accident!
No, perhaps it was deliberate...
So all of this is... You know, what was his name?
...That marshal who looks as though he's plotting something..."
Celica: "...Marshal Revios?"
Murk: "Yes, that's the one. The way I see it,
he is... Hm? No, that wasn't it.
Er, what were we talking about?"
Ymir: "The accident at the laboratory..."
Murk: "Oh, yes, exactly.
It may have been made to look like an accident.
That, what was it called? You know..."
Touya (Is this old guy going senile?)
Murk: "Hey, youngster!"
Touya: "Huh? Me?"
Murk: "Who else? Or are you
not as young as you look?"
Touya: "I'm seventeen!"
Murk: "Hmph. Still a mere chick, then.
You're less than a quarter of my age!"
Touya: "I don't see why you're bragging about being old...
Anyway, what do you want?"
Murk: "What do I want?"
Touya: "Don't give me that!
You're the one who called out to me!"
Murk: "Oh, yes. I hear you piloted that thing.
You know, what was it called? Um..."
Touya: "You mean Rayblade?"
Murk: "Yes, that's it. Rayblade.
My, my. Impressive for someone so young."
Touya: "No, I don't think age has anything to do with..."
Murk: "And how old are you?"
Touya: "...No good. He's completely senile."
Murk: "I'm joking. Seventeen, aren't you? That much
is plain for a man of my talents to see."
Touya: "...Hey, do something about him, will you?"
Ymir: "Ah, um... Dr. Berol,
what about the accident at the laboratory?"
Murk: "Yes, that. I was saying that it might
have happened that way."
Ymir: "..."
Murk: "Well, then, I suppose it's about time..."
Touya: "Hey! Don't just wrap things up on your own!
What the hell do you want?!"
Murk: "Oh, yes! I nearly forgot."
Touya (You'd completely forgotten...)
Murk: "Did you say something, youngster?"
Touya: "N-no. Anyway, what is it?"
Murk: "Yes. You know that Muur Forest up ahead
has become a Baluamy nest, I assume.
Now, those Baluamy are troublesome creatures.
Unless you defeat the Queen, they will keep reproducing
forever."
Touya: "You're the one who made them, right?"
Murk: "Indeed. Sometimes my own genius frightens me.
Well, never mind that. Wouldn't you like to know
where that Queen is?"
Ymir: "Leaving them as they are would be a problem..."
Murk: "Well said! Just what I'd expect of Rakbal's student!
You understand reason! Your eyes are shining!
And besides... Oh, I seem to have strayed just a little off topic.
...Now, I'll send the coordinates. I'm counting on you."
Touya: "H-hey! You're going to make us do it all by ourselves?!
Isn't that a little too convenient for you?"
Murk: "Of course, I don't expect you to do it for nothing.
From what I've heard, you're looking for
leads on Ze=Ode.
If you get rid of the Queen, why don't I give you
some particularly valuable information I know?
You will gain a reputation for defeating dangerous creatures,
as well as information on Ze=Ode.
Not a bad deal, I should think."
Ymir: "...We certainly cannot leave the Baluamy
as they are.
And eliminating them would give us something useful
to show the outside world.
...Captain, is that all right?"
Captain Roa: "Mm."
Murk: "Then I'm counting on you..."
Touya: "Rayblade still isn't an option?"
Celica: "No. It's nearly ready,
but take Zeifon out this time."
Touya: "Got it. Hey, by the way,
what's that thing under the blackout curtain or whatever it is?"
Celica: "Heh heh heh. It's a secret."
Touya: "You're making something dodgy again..."
Celica: "No, it isn't like that.
The adjustments are nearly finished,
and I'll unveil it when they're done."
Touya: "Well, I'll look forward to it. More or less."
Kasumi: "Oh, Touya-chan..."
Touya: "Hm? What's wrong? It's dangerous to stay here.
Wait on the bridge."
Kasumi: "Ai-chan taught me the basics
of operating it earlier. So..."
Clovis: "Heeey! What are you two flirting about?
Come on, let's go!"
Touya: "Anyway, we'll take care of it this time.
Please wait here."
Kasumi: "But..."
Touya: "There's no need to rush it."
Kasumi: "...O-okay. I understand."
Touya: "Well, I'm off."
Kasumi: "Be careful."

review_batches.context: After Kasumi's rescue, the group discusses responsibility and her wish to join; Aurelie challenges her motives. Read the entire 652-row member, including both choice branches and the departure scenes.
review_batches.decisions: Preserve Kasumi's request to help, Aurelie's harsh warning and the defend/stay-quiet choice as separate source rows. Keep Lodis's hand/eye-contact misunderstanding and Sisk's silent stare. Familiar addresses use existing conventions. Row continuations, hesitations and address-only lines are deliberate fragments; no byte-budget shortening.

row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o00114.l00: Nested quotation reports the politicians' complaint; Lodis is not himself ordering the ship detained.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o001f8.l00: Touya is angry at Forzen's glib happy ending and negligence. Preserve the accusation instead of toning it down to mild concern.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o0028b.l00: Kasumi credits Forzen with helping her distress and rejects Touya's blame. Her view does not erase the earlier transport mishap.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o0040e.l00: Keep both taking hands and looking into eyes, since Celica explicitly names the behavior behind the misunderstanding.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o0052a.l00: Kasumi asks to assist the group; do not reverse this into a request that the group help her.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o00585.l00: Pilot aptitude is reported as something she has been told, not a completed aptitude test; Lodis later requires testing.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o0069f.l00: Aurelie criticizes the motive of staying near a loved boy and calls Kasumi a burden; preserve the harshness and the possible danger to others.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o0078f.l00: Player choice defends Kasumi; the other option remains staying quiet. Do not replace either choice with a narrator summary.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o00821.l02: Explicit possibility of killing someone and following warning of Kasumi's own death remain unsoftened.

review_batches.context: First branch: Clovis explains Aurelie's concern and Touya reassures Kasumi. Alternate branch: Fain intervenes, then shared discussion transitions to Ze=Ode intelligence. All 652 rows examined.
review_batches.decisions: Do not join alternate branches into one conversation. Retain potential killing, guilt, Aurelie's earlier experience as spoken context, Fain's mistaken lie accusation and full-name declaration. Keep Kasumi's pilot-candidate status distinct from confirmed assignment and aptitude testing. Source interruptions and row continuations remain fragments.

row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o00971.l02: Clovis describes Kasumi eventually taking a life, then possible crushing guilt, and relates that to Aurelie's earlier experience. Preserve the certainty/possibility difference as his speech.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o00b59.l00: Kasumi asks whether she may stay and worries about burdening the group; Touya's next question and promise answer that concern.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o00c8e.l00: Begins the alternate stay-quiet route rather than another event after Touya's reassurance; source order retained without merging branches.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o00ca4.p01.l00: Fain's reference to God's permission is extravagant rhetoric. Preserve the full force and full name, not a new religious doctrine.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o00d55.l01: Fain cannot finish the promise; Clovis supplies protect her in the next row. Keep the stammered object and omission.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o010ff.l00: Fain explicitly promises to protect Kasumi; the request direction differs from Kasumi asking the group to let her help.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o0115d.l00: Kasumi joins as a pilot candidate pending an aptitude test; no assigned mech or immediate deployment is invented.

review_batches.context: Ze=Ode's possible plans, Goderius, Zigrim's president and military influence, then Agarthia's ownership demands and the new research organization. Read all 652 rows including both later political and military discussions.
review_batches.decisions: Distinguish rumor, hypothesis and a speaker's stated certainty. Preserve six machines, no time-control claim, named officials, both ownership alternatives and the separate council/assembly labels. The political claims remain character dialogue, not real-world legal conclusions. All boundaries and deliberate fragments retained.

row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o01392.l00: Six machines and Goderius as central member are reported as lore; the absence of confirmed appearance stays an observation, not proof of nonexistence.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o0144d.l00: Ymir denies controllable time travel, calls the appearance accidental and distinguishes her uncertainty about means from certainty that they wait for Goderius/Dr. Debish.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o01520.l04: Horem is the president mentioned by Garyud in the report; keep Arthur's suggested connection as a question.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o015ac.l03: Puppet presidency is a rumor. Do not convert it into narration or assume real-world constitutional powers.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o0162f.l00: Dead weight localizes the idle daylight-lamp idiom while keeping the expression for Touya's following comment; no extra literal lamp is introduced.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o016bd.l00: Xiujian infers the president is a separate matter from Garyud's wording; preserve it as his reasoning, not a proven conspiracy map.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o0185a.l03: Preserve the asserted design-based ownership claim and both demands. It remains an in-world government claim, not an endorsed legal finding.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o0185a.l10: Chairman Rakbal works on the assembly; don't collapse the separately named council and assembly into a single institution without proof.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o01aaf.l00: Lodis announces a research organization based on the Liebhofen, not incorporation into Agarthia's military or a new formal name absent from the source.

review_batches.context: Ivel sends Ymir as her representative; Celica is told not to leave; Revios and Geel discuss public expectations, war, army duty, prototypes and unauthorized acts. Read all 652 rows, including the continuation of the laboratory rebuke at 320-322.
review_batches.decisions: Settle the direction of Ymir's proposed help from Ivel's answer: she offers to stay, but is sent with the ship. Keep beast-taming metaphor, political cynicism and Revios's distinction between the system and its people. Preserve two whitespace-only source rows and all speech boundaries; final speech continues beyond this slice.

row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o01c83.l00: Ymir offers to remain with Ivel in the political work. Ivel refuses and tells her to see the truth and travel with the ship, settling the intended direction.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o01d5c.l00: Ivel wants Ymir recognized as her representative to strengthen their negotiations; not recognition as Ivel's successor.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o01f19.l00: Revios judges the ownership move too late because public hopes already support the pilots; do not state that he controls that public response.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o02109.l00: Keep the whole beast-taming metaphor: not removing fangs, but weakening and subduing it, then waiting for unmet public expectations to produce backlash.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o021af.l02: Source row contains a space only, between parts of Geel's same speech. Preserve it as a spacer, not an invented line of dialogue.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o0221e.l00: The failed negotiators are criticized for brandishing national prestige; the line does not say Zigrim alone caused the negotiation failure.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o022a2.l00: Revios addresses Geel as Colonel and insists the military obey government decisions. Preserve this distinction despite his political maneuvering.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o0230e.l00: He says he objects to the people within the national system, not to the system itself; do not reverse the distinction.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o0230e.l02: Whitespace-only source spacer retained within Revios's speech.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o02427.l00: Prototype tests and mass-production suitability are separate stages; do not claim Renbardon is already being mass-produced under this plan.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o02507.l00: Revios's rebuke continues at 320-321; keep its opening quote and withhold the incomplete block from insertion.

review_batches.context: Revios's laboratory rebuke ends; the Liebhofen loads Rayblade, Touya notices Ymir's scent, Maki sneaks aboard and Ai makes friends with Kasumi. Read all 652 rows including both romance-question branches.
review_batches.decisions: Preserve the distinction between fault in security and hiring a poor hacker, incomplete Rayblade repairs and unresolved scent memory. Keep three timed punctuation rows with every wait. Forms of address matter to the Ai/Kasumi exchange: formal Miss Ai shifts to Ai-chan while Touya-chan remains familiar. All physical boundaries and deliberate fragments retained.

row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o02507.l01: Completes Revios's speech from 319: inadequate security is one fault, hiring the hacker is a worse one. The subsequent acknowledgment does not independently narrate the full sabotage details.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o026b5.l00: Ivel orders Rayblade taken because leaving it is dangerous; the following line explains the risk as potential seizure after the other mechs leave.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o02766.l00: Touya's interrupted thought shifts from Rayblade to a scent. Do not identify the earlier occasion or source of the scent beyond what he says.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o0288b.l00: Timing-only row: each source two-dot leader becomes two ASCII periods; keep every FC:02:3E wait and exact row boundary.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o0288b.l01: Timing-only continuation with every wait preserved.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o0288b.l02: Timing-only continuation; no added speaker or narrative.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o02a34.l00: Maki's next Roguewar Prize is a boast. Preserve her intent to uncover Rayblade's true nature, not proof that she already knows it.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o02b3b.l00: Miss Ai makes the polite san address visible in English so Ai's immediate request for plain Ai has a clear referent.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o02bf5.l00: If I may ask carries Kasumi's continued politeness that Ai calls out in the next row.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o02cc7.l00: Keep Ai-chan because the following explicit naming agreement depends on it. This is a local form-of-address scene, not a blanket decision to retain all honorifics.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o02d7d.l00: Kasumi corrects a formal yes to casual yeah, matching her effort to drop polite speech.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o02ee1.l01: Ai's how far question is suggestive but nonspecific; keep it without inventing an explicit act.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o02f85.l01: Kasumi says only a kiss occurred, then explains it as accidental. Preserve both claims and Ai's surprise; do not assert an established romantic relationship.

review_batches.context: Ai and Kasumi's alternative relationship conversations, mechanics' loading banter, Celica's farewell message and Derock's suspicious baggage. Read the whole 652-row member, including the later stowaway reveal.
review_batches.decisions: Keep alternate replies separate, the accidental-kiss account as Kasumi's statement, teasing and reassurance without inventing a confirmed couple. Preserve the three named machines, chief/traitor banter and the whole message's first-person direction. Derock's verbal tick and panting remain. Row continuations, hesitation and incomplete thoughts are deliberate.

row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o0308f.l01: Continues Ai's apology from 399 before accepting Kasumi's account; don't merge physical rows to repair the cross-slice sentence.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o03131.l01: Childhood friends becoming a couple is Ai's trope-based pretext; Kasumi explicitly points out its manga context.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o03236.l00: Alternate branch begins here rather than a conversation after Ai's exit at 409. Keep source order without making both branches sequential events.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o03317.l01: Ai begins acknowledging Touya might save anyone, then backtracks to comfort Kasumi. The later teasing reveals Kasumi knows his kindness is general.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o033b6.l00: Kasumi's previous disappointed silence was a tease. I was kidding preserves the reversal that prompts Ai's you tricked me.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o034e8.l00: Keep Forstin, Orbest and Ahti, three specific machine names, and distinguish the later loading of spare parts and that thing.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o035c8.l00: No gender is inferred for the anonymous mechanic; the first-person offer requires none.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o036b1.l01: Keep the willingness to become a national traitor as the mechanic's exaggerated loyalty; the foreman disclaims going that far.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o0382c.l00: Celica's message stays first person throughout all eight physical rows; do not treat it as the receiving character's spoken instructions.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o0382c.l06: Celica leaves the remaining affairs to Lodis. Preserve who is asking whom rather than turning it into her offering assistance.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o0395f.l00: Ivel offers Lodis support in handling the aftermath; this is separate from her earlier instruction that Ymir go with the ship.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o03a77.l01: Derock claims the contents are private and dangerous; the eventual reveal contradicts his cover story. Do not endorse the warning as narrator fact.

review_batches.context: A voice from Derock's bag reveals Celica; the ship has no destination and another engine issue; Murk interrupts with his introduction and account of the research accident. Read all 652 rows and the preceding laboratory rebuke.
review_batches.decisions: Keep concealed voice until Celica is revealed, Ymir's acceptance conditional on Celica explaining herself, chief designer role, engine navigation conditions, Murk's full name and five-year teacher/director history. His claim of accident shifts to suspicion of sabotage; do not make either established fact. Preserve every source row and deliberate interruption.

row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o03b57.l00: Unidentified pain cry from the bag remains ??? until the source reveals Celica at 490.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o03c1e.l00: Touya restrains Derock while asking Ymir to deal with the bag. Keep the object vague as in the source; do not invent her striking or restraining a person.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o03d52.l00: Ymir will report Celica's presence to Lodis, but Celica must also explain herself. Acceptance does not mean prior authorization.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o042dd.l00: Navigation is expected to be safe if they avoid pushing the engine, unlike the previous issue. Do not claim repairs are complete or failure impossible.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o04410.l00: Murk addresses the ship's crew with an introduction even though some already know him. Preserve the comic formal full name.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o04502.l00: Murk taught Rakbal, and Ymir attended some lectures; do not make Murk her sole mentor or confuse him with Rakbal himself.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o04502.l02: The source abbreviates the institute to Artificial Evolution Research Institute here; do not insert the unspoken Brufle name.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o0456b.p01.l00: Source one-character Kazetto/Gazette spelling variation normalized to the established Gazette Project, confirmed by Ymir's immediate response and glossary.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o0465a.l00: Murk first asserts accident, then suggests deliberate interference and loses his train of thought. Preserve his shifting claims rather than settling sabotage from this speech alone.

review_batches.context: Murk's rambling exchange with Touya leads to the Queen-hunting bargain, then Rayblade's repair status and the covered machine. All 652 rows examined, with final Kasumi deployment discussion following.
review_batches.decisions: Keep Touya's age seventeen, less-than-quarter comparison without inventing Murk's exact age, senility insults as Touya's words/thoughts, the Queen reproduction condition, reputation/information bargain and request direction. Preserve all fragments and row boundaries. No technical additions or shortening for layout.

row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o047a6.l00: Touya's internal senility insult is not a medical diagnosis or narrator fact. Keep the insult's force.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o04822.l00: Exact age seventeen and less-than-quarter comparison retained. Do not calculate or assign Murk a precise age.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o049b5.l00: Murk claims he was joking and remembers seventeen. Do not resolve whether earlier rambling was feigned or genuine.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o04a47.l00: May have happened that way refers back to the possibility of an accident staged deliberately, not a new incident.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o04af9.l00: Inner thought that Murk had completely forgotten is followed by Murk apparently noticing; don't change it to ordinary quoted speech.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o04b53.l03: The Queen must be defeated to stop continuing reproduction, according to Murk. Keep the condition and forever claim without adding a biological mechanism.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o04c5b.l03: I'm counting on you is Murk asking the crew to act, not him offering to perform the mission.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o04d14.l00: The promised payment is information and reputation, not money or a guaranteed material reward.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o04de1.p01.l00: Ymir sees external political value in eliminating the creatures; do not reduce the motivation to only scientific data collection.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o04f0b.l00: Negative answer to Rayblade being an option: no, it is not ready. Explicitly direct Touya to use Zeifon this time.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o04f37.l01: Covered thing remains unnamed. Do not reveal what Celica will unveil later.

review_batches.context: Final twelve rows: Kasumi wants to join after Ai's basic instruction, but Touya tells her to wait on the bridge while the others deploy. All 652 source rows examined.
review_batches.decisions: Keep her unfinished offer, Clovis's teasing, Touya's reassurance and promise to return. Do not equate basic controls with certified readiness or confirm an assigned sortie. One physical row in, one row out; interruptions and address-only reactions remain deliberate.

row_decisions.scenario.s_00a.o05045.l00: Kasumi knows basic operation from Ai, then leaves her offer unfinished. Touya still tells her to wait; don't invent completed combat training.
